<page>
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
Pearland, TX
Phone 281-555-1704
Settlement Demand
June 4, 2024
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1182 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
I write to present a claim on behalf of our client, Lisa Mcdaniel, arising from a collision that occurred on December 9,
2023. Our client was traveling in the right lane when the vehicle insured by your company moved into the same lane
without signaling or confirming that the way was clear. The resulting sideswipe forced our client's vehicle against the
guardrail and caused a significant impact to the driver's side.
As a direct result of the collision, our client suffered a fracture of the wrist. Treatment has included emergency
evaluation, immobilization, and a follow-up coruse of care with a specialist, and our client continues to experience
pain, reduced grip strength, and restricted movement. Our client has also missed time from work and has been
unable to perform routine daily tasks during recovery.
The police report documents the lane change as the cause of the incident, and the physical damage to our client's
vehicle is consistent with the account described. Liability rests squarely with your insured.
Our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation. We demand payment of $50,000.00 within thirty days of
the date of this letter. Should we not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further
notice.
Expert review: Katherine Moore, accident reconstructionist
Sincerely,
Kyle Sanders
Marshall & Dominguez LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
